Remark
[Notation $H^k$ and identification a.e.] ↗ def:sobolev-space-wkp 1. ch5:5.2-rem-1\group Sobolev Spaces

(i) If $p = 2$, we usually write \[ H^k(U) = W^{k,2}(U) \quad (k = 0, 1, \ldots ). \] In particular, $H^0(U) = L^2(U)$.

(ii) Functions in $W^{k,p}(U)$ that agree a.e. are identified.
